svg.title: Position, velocity and acceleration of a ball released from rest
svg.desc: At equal 0.1 s intervals the ball falls increasingly far. With upward positive and g = 9.8 m/s², y = −4.9t², v = −9.8t and a = −9.8 m/s². The table and all three graphs show the same motion from 0 to 0.5 s. An animated companion below illustrates the process; its complete static alternative is shown for reduced motion and print.

g.text: Free fall: position and velocity share one clock
After 0.50 s: downward distance 1.225 m, speed 4.90 m/s; g = 9.80 m/s².
Illustrative motion • slowed down • cycle restarts
